sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Remove the unconditional sh:in (nltl:polarShipCategoryA nltl:polarShipCategoryB) from the shipCategory property shape. The canonical range also permits Category C, and this requirement must not reject non-applicable Category C ships; applicability belongs in the conditional SPARQL logic. Preserve the conditional absence handling for category, date, capacities, and separation. Rewrite the separation violation branch explicitly so an applicable ship is selected when no separation is reported or when any reported separation is below 0.76 m, without allowing a qualifying value to mask an inadequate value.
